s: 因为能赶上比赛，他六点就出门了。
s_py: yīn wèi néng gǎn shàng bǐ sài tā liù diǎn jiù chū mén le
zh: 为了能赶上比赛，他六点就出门了。
py: wèi le néng gǎn shàng bǐ sài tā liù diǎn jiù chū mén le
en: In order to be able to catch the match, he left home at six.
why: Catching the match is the goal that makes him leave early, not a cause. A goal takes 为了.

q: 如果你在路上迷路的话，你___给我打电话，我去接你。
zh: 如果你在路上迷路的话，你就给我打电话，我去接你。
py: rú guǒ nǐ zài lù shang mí lù de huà nǐ jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà wǒ qù jiē nǐ
en: If you get lost on the way, just call me and I'll come and pick you up.
why: 如果…(的话) takes 就 after the second subject 你. 才 would make calling the only thing allowed, and 而且 adds information.

zh: 除了足球，他还喜欢打篮球和游泳。
py: chú le zú qiú tā hái xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú hé yóu yǒng
en: Besides football, he also likes basketball and swimming.
why: 还 adds to the 除了 item and stands after the subject 他, before 喜欢.

q: 只要你按时到，教练___让你上场。
zh: 只要你按时到，教练就让你上场。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ àn shí dào jiào liàn jiù ràng nǐ shàng chǎng
en: As long as you arrive on time, the coach will let you play.
why: 只要 means one easy condition is enough, so 就. 才 would turn it into 'only then', which is 只有.

zh: 这家面馆又便宜又干净。
py: zhè jiā miàn guǎn yòu pián yi yòu gān jìng
en: This noodle shop is both cheap and clean.
why: 又 comes before each quality, and no 很 sits inside the pattern. The two qualities can swap places.

src: 晴天他去公园跑步，下雨天他也去。
src_py: qíng tiān tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù xià yǔ tiān tā yě qù
zh: 不管晴天还是雨天，他都去公园跑步。
py: bù guǎn qíng tiān hái shi yǔ tiān tā dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: Rain or shine, he goes running in the park.
why: 不管 takes the choice question 晴天还是雨天, and 都 follows the subject 他.

src: 他回到家，马上给妈妈打电话。
src_py: tā huí dào jiā mǎ shàng gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
zh: 他一回到家就给妈妈打电话。
py: tā yī huí dào jiā jiù gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
en: As soon as he gets home he calls his mum.
why: 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 before the second; the shared subject is stated once at the front.

q: 这家球馆不但便宜，___离地铁站很近。
zh: 这家球馆不但便宜，还离地铁站很近。
py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn bù dàn pián yi hái lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn
en: This gym is not only cheap, it is also close to the subway station.
why: 不但 takes 而且, 还 or 也 after it. 就 and 才 are partners of 如果 and 只有.

src: 最近来体育馆的人变多了。
src_py: zuì jìn lái tǐ yù guǎn de rén biàn duō le
task: Say there are more and more of them.
zh: 最近来体育馆的人越来越多了。
py: zuì jìn lái tǐ yù guǎn de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
en: More and more people have been coming to the gym lately.
why: 越来越 replaces 变 and sits directly before the adjective 多.

zh: 你先往前走，然后在第二个路口往右转。
py: nǐ xiān wǎng qián zǒu rán hòu zài dì èr gè lù kǒu wǎng yòu zhuǎn
en: Go straight first, then turn right at the second intersection.
why: 先 marks step one, 然后 the next step. The place phrase stays before the verb 往右转.

q: 他一看地图___明白了该怎么走。
zh: 他一看地图就明白了该怎么走。
py: tā yī kàn dì tú jiù míng bai le gāi zěn me zǒu
en: The moment he looked at the map, he understood which way to go.
why: 一…就 means 'the moment one does the first thing, the second follows'. 才 cannot be paired with 一.

q: 因为公交车坏了，___我们走路去体育馆。
zh: 因为公交车坏了，所以我们走路去体育馆。
py: yīn wèi gōng jiāo chē huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ men zǒu lù qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: Because the bus broke down, we walked to the gym.
why: 因为 is answered by 所以 before the result. 但是 would signal a contrast and 而且 an addition.

q: 尽管天气很热，他们___在操场上踢球。
zh: 尽管天气很热，他们还是在操场上踢球。
py: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn rè tā men hái shi zài cāo chǎng shàng tī qiú
en: Even though it was hot, they still played football on the field.
why: 尽管 states a fact, and the result goes against it: 还是 'still'. 因此 and 而且 do not express contrast.

zh: 只要你想去，我们就一起去。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ xiǎng qù wǒ men jiù yī qǐ qù
en: As long as you want to go, we'll go together.
why: 就 follows the second subject 我们 and comes before 一起去; it cannot come before 我们.

q: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店___关门了，所以我只能来这里买运动鞋。
zh: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店都关门了，所以我只能来这里买运动鞋。
py: chú le zhè jiā diàn yǐ wài fù jìn de shāng diàn dōu guān mén le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ néng lái zhè lǐ mǎi yùn dòng xié
en: Except for this shop, all the shops nearby are closed, so I can only buy sports shoes here.
why: This shop is the exception and all the others are closed: 都. 还 would add to it, contradicting 只能来这里.

zh: 他不是在跑步，而是在散步。
py: tā bù shì zài pǎo bù ér shì zài sàn bù
en: He isn't running; he's taking a stroll.
why: 不是 A 而是 B puts the denied option first and the correct one after 而是.

zh: 为了赶上末班地铁，他们跑着去了车站。
py: wèi le gǎn shàng mò bān dì tiě tā men pǎo zhe qù le chē zhàn
en: To catch the last subway, they ran to the station.
why: 为了 opens the goal clause. The goal comes before the action it explains.

zh: 他一下场就去喝水。
py: tā yī xià chǎng jiù qù hē shuǐ
en: As soon as he leaves the court, he goes to drink some water.
why: 一 stands directly before the first verb 下场 and 就 before the second. 一 cannot open the clause before 他.

q: 只有每天练习，你___能游得更快。
zh: 只有每天练习，你才能游得更快。
py: zhǐ yǒu měi tiān liàn xí nǐ cái néng yóu de gèng kuài
en: Only by practising every day can you swim faster.
why: 只有 names the only condition that works and takes 才. 就 goes with 只要.

zh: 我们先去地铁站，再去体育馆。
py: wǒ men xiān qù dì tiě zhàn zài qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: We'll go to the subway station first, then to the gym.
why: 先 stands before the first step and 再 before the second, both directly in front of their verbs.

q: 只有天气好，我们___去爬山。
zh: 只有天气好，我们才去爬山。
py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men cái qù pá shān
en: We'll go hiking only if the weather is good.
why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

s: 不管你喜不喜欢，他都要去体育馆。
s_py: bù guǎn nǐ xǐ bu xǐ huan tā dōu yào qù tǐ yù guǎn
zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，他都要去体育馆。
py: bù guǎn nǐ xǐ bu xǐ huan tā dōu yào qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: Whether you like it or not, he's going to the gym.
why: This is correct: 不管 has the verb-not-verb question 喜不喜欢, and 都 follows the subject 他.

s: 他下班以后不是去健身房，就是去公园跑步。
s_py: tā xià bān yǐ hòu bù shì qù jiàn shēn fáng jiù shì qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
zh: 他下班以后不是去健身房，就是去公园跑步。
py: tā xià bān yǐ hòu bù shì qù jiàn shēn fáng jiù shì qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: After work he either goes to the gym or goes running in the park.
why: This is correct: 不是 A 就是 B says it is always one of the two.

zh: 只有多练习，你才能打好网球。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng dǎ hǎo wǎng qiú
en: Only by practising a lot can you play tennis well.
why: 才 follows the subject 你 and stands before the modal 能. It cannot come before 你.

q: ___昨天输了比赛，但是大家一点儿也不难过。
zh: 虽然昨天输了比赛，但是大家一点儿也不难过。
py: suī rán zuó tiān shū le bǐ sài dàn shì dà jiā yī diǎn r yě bù nán guò
en: Although we lost the match yesterday, nobody is sad at all.
why: Losing yesterday is a real fact, so 虽然 with 但是. 即使 would treat it as a mere supposition.

zh: 不管路有多远，他每天都骑车去上班。
py: bù guǎn lù yǒu duō yuǎn tā měi tiān dōu qí chē qù shàng bān
en: However far the road is, he cycles to work every day.
why: 都 comes after the subject and 每天 and before the verb phrase.

q: 他不是去跑步，___去爬山。
zh: 他不是去跑步，而是去爬山。
py: tā bù shì qù pǎo bù ér shì qù pá shān
en: He isn't going running; he's going hiking.
why: The cue corrects one fact with another: 不是 A 而是 B. 就是 would make it 'either A or B', and 但是 does not pair with 不是.

q: 我一到公园___看见很多人在打球。
zh: 我一到公园就看见很多人在打球。
py: wǒ yī dào gōng yuán jiù kàn jiàn hěn duō rén zài dǎ qiú
en: As soon as I got to the park, I saw lots of people playing ball.
why: 一…就 means 'as soon as': 就 follows right behind the first action. 才 would say it happened late.

zh: 他周末不是踢球，就是游泳。
py: tā zhōu mò bù shì tī qiú jiù shì yóu yǒng
en: At weekends he either plays football or goes swimming.
why: 不是 A 就是 B: the two parts come in this order, and 就是 starts the second option.

q: ___我喜欢游泳，所以每个周末都去游泳馆。
zh: 因为我喜欢游泳，所以每个周末都去游泳馆。
py: yīn wèi wǒ xǐ huan yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng guǎn
en: Because I like swimming, I go to the swimming pool every weekend.
why: 所以 introduces a result, so the first clause must give the reason: 因为. 虽然 and 如果 do not pair with 所以.

s: 他一边骑车，一边听音乐，非常危险。
s_py: tā yī biān qí chē yī biān tīng yīn yuè fēi cháng wēi xiǎn
zh: 他一边骑车，一边听音乐，非常危险。
py: tā yī biān qí chē yī biān tīng yīn yuè fēi cháng wēi xiǎn
en: He listens to music while riding, which is very dangerous.
why: This is correct: 一边…一边 joins two simultaneous actions, and 很/非常 appears only in a separate clause.

q: 虽然今天很冷，___我还是去跑步了。
zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是去跑步了。
py: suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng dàn shì wǒ hái shi qù pǎo bù le
en: Although it is cold today, I still went running.
why: 虽然 states a fact and the second clause turns against it with 但是. 所以 and 因为 would claim the cold caused or explains the run.

q: 即使这家餐厅离体育馆很远，我们___会去，因为那里的面条非常好吃。
zh: 即使这家餐厅离体育馆很远，我们也会去，因为那里的面条非常好吃。
py: jí shǐ zhè jiā cān tīng lí tǐ yù guǎn hěn yuǎn wǒ men yě huì qù yīn wèi nà lǐ de miàn tiáo fēi cháng hǎo chī
en: Even if this restaurant is far from the stadium, we'll go, because the noodles there are very good.
why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the subject. 但是 belongs with 虽然.

q: 虽然他才十岁，___他游得比大人还快。
zh: 虽然他才十岁，但是他游得比大人还快。
py: suī rán tā cái shí suì dàn shì tā yóu de bǐ dà rén hái kuài
en: Although he is only ten, he swims faster than adults.
why: 虽然 sets up a surprising contrast, and 但是 comes before the second subject. 而且 and 所以 do not mark a contrast.

zh: 虽然比赛很难，但是我们赢了。
py: suī rán bǐ sài hěn nán dàn shì wǒ men yíng le
en: Although the match was hard, we won.
why: 但是 is a conjunction and stands before the second subject 我们, not after it.

s: 他的篮球打得越来越很好了。
s_py: tā de lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hěn hǎo le
zh: 他的篮球打得越来越好了。
py: tā de lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: His basketball is getting better and better.
why: 越来越 already expresses degree, so 很 cannot follow it.

s: 这家店的面一边便宜一边好吃。
s_py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn yī biān pián yi yī biān hǎo chī
zh: 这家店的面又便宜又好吃。
py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī
en: The noodles at this shop are both cheap and tasty.
why: 一边…一边 joins two actions done at the same time. Two qualities need 又…又.

src: 这个公园很大，也很漂亮。
src_py: zhè ge gōng yuán hěn dà yě hěn piào liang
task: Join the two qualities with 又…又.
zh: 这个公园又大又漂亮。
py: zhè ge gōng yuán yòu dà yòu piào liang
en: This park is both big and pretty.
why: 又 is placed before each adjective and 很 is dropped.

zh: 他一边走路，一边听音乐。
py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān tīng yīn yuè
en: He listens to music while walking.
why: 一边…一边 joins two simultaneous actions. Each 一边 stands right before its verb.

q: 他既会打篮球，___会踢足球。
zh: 他既会打篮球，又会踢足球。
py: tā jì huì dǎ lán qiú yòu huì tī zú qiú
en: He can play both basketball and football.
why: 既 is answered by 又 (or 也): 既…又. 而且 belongs with 不但, and 所以 states a result.

s: 如果你不去，我也不去了。
s_py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ yě bù qù le
zh: 如果你不去，我也不去了。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ yě bù qù le
en: If you don't go, I won't go either.
why: This is correct. 也 is an adverb after the second subject 我, and 就 is not required in an if-clause.

q: 骑自行车不但可以锻炼身体，___可以省钱。
zh: 骑自行车不但可以锻炼身体，还可以省钱。
py: qí zì xíng chē bù dàn kě yǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ hái kě yǐ shěng qián
en: Cycling not only exercises the body, it also saves money.
why: 不但 … 还 adds a second benefit. 就 and 才 would turn the sentence into a condition.

q: 这条路又宽___干净。
zh: 这条路又宽又干净。
py: zhè tiáo lù yòu kuān yòu gān jìng
en: This road is both wide and clean.
why: 又 must be repeated in front of each quality: 又宽又干净. 也 and 更 do not complete the pair.

q: 他一边走路，___看手机，差点儿撞到人。
zh: 他一边走路，一边看手机，差点儿撞到人。
py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān kàn shǒu jī chà diǎn r zhuàng dào rén
en: He was looking at his phone while walking and almost bumped into someone.
why: Two actions happening at the same time are joined by 一边…一边. 又 or 再 cannot make the second action simultaneous.

s: 一他到球场，就开始热身。
s_py: yī tā dào qiú chǎng jiù kāi shǐ rè shēn
zh: 他一到球场，就开始热身。
py: tā yī dào qiú chǎng jiù kāi shǐ rè shēn
en: As soon as he gets to the court, he starts warming up.
why: 一 must stand after the subject, right before the first verb. It cannot come before 他.

q: ___参加比赛，他每天早上都练习打篮球。
zh: 为了参加比赛，他每天早上都练习打篮球。
py: wèi le cān jiā bǐ sài tā měi tiān zǎo shang dōu liàn xí dǎ lán qiú
en: In order to take part in the match, he practises basketball every morning.
why: Taking part in the match is the goal he works toward, so 为了 is needed. 因为 states a cause that has already happened.

s: 只有穿上跑鞋，他就愿意出门。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu chuān shàng pǎo xié tā jiù yuàn yì chū mén
zh: 只有穿上跑鞋，他才愿意出门。
py: zhǐ yǒu chuān shàng pǎo xié tā cái yuàn yì chū mén
en: Only if he puts on his running shoes is he willing to go out.
why: 只有 is answered by 才. 就 is the partner of 只要 and 如果.

q: 如果这家店的球鞋太贵，我___去别的店看看。
zh: 如果这家店的球鞋太贵，我就去别的店看看。
py: rú guǒ zhè jiā diàn de qiú xié tài guì wǒ jiù qù bié de diàn kàn kan
en: If the shoes in this shop are too expensive, I'll look in other shops.
why: 如果 pairs with 就 after the second subject 我. 才 would mean 'only then' and 都 needs 不管.

q: 他一下班___去健身房，从来不回家吃饭。
zh: 他一下班就去健身房，从来不回家吃饭。
py: tā yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng cóng lái bù huí jiā chī fàn
en: As soon as he finishes work he goes to the gym; he never goes home for dinner.
why: 一…就 links two actions that follow at once. 才 would say he goes late, and 再 needs 先 before it.

q: 由于下大雨，___足球比赛改到了下周。
zh: 由于下大雨，因此足球比赛改到了下周。
py: yóu yú xià dà yǔ yīn cǐ zú qiú bǐ sài gǎi dào le xià zhōu
en: Owing to the heavy rain, the football match was moved to next week.
why: 由于 is answered by 因此 in front of the result clause. 因为 cannot follow 由于, and 虽然 is contrastive.

s: 如果下雨，就我们不去了。
s_py: rú guǒ xià yǔ jiù wǒ men bù qù le
zh: 如果下雨，我们就不去了。
py: rú guǒ xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
en: If it rains, we won't go.
why: 就 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们, not come before it.

s: 不管比赛很难，我们都不放弃。
s_py: bù guǎn bǐ sài hěn nán wǒ men dōu bù fàng qì
zh: 不管比赛难不难，我们都不放弃。
py: bù guǎn bǐ sài nán bu nán wǒ men dōu bù fàng qì
en: Whether the match is hard or not, we won't give up.
why: 不管 needs an open question such as 难不难. A plain statement like 很难 cannot follow it.

q: ___你明天不想去，我们也得去体育馆报名。
zh: 就算你明天不想去，我们也得去体育馆报名。
py: jiù suàn nǐ míng tiān bù xiǎng qù wǒ men yě děi qù tǐ yù guǎn bào míng
en: Even if you don't want to go tomorrow, we still have to go and sign up at the gym.
why: The first clause is a supposed case about tomorrow, so 就算 (even if) with 也. 虽然 states something already true.

q: 既然地铁站人这么多，我们___走路去吧。
zh: 既然地铁站人这么多，我们就走路去吧。
py: jì rán dì tiě zhàn rén zhè me duō wǒ men jiù zǒu lù qù ba
en: Since there are so many people at the subway station, let's walk.
why: 既然 gives a known situation and 就 leads into the suggestion. 才 would mean 'only then'.

q: 你应该先拉伸一下，___开始跑步，不然容易受伤。
zh: 你应该先拉伸一下，再开始跑步，不然容易受伤。
py: nǐ yīng gāi xiān lā shēn yī xià zài kāi shǐ pǎo bù bù rán róng yì shòu shāng
en: You should stretch first and then start running, or you'll easily get hurt.
why: 先…再 orders two steps in advice. 又 means 'again' and 也 means 'also'; neither marks the next step.

s: 除了游泳，他也喜欢爬山。
s_py: chú le yóu yǒng tā yě xǐ huan pá shān
zh: 除了游泳，他也喜欢爬山。
py: chú le yóu yǒng tā yě xǐ huan pá shān
en: Besides swimming, he also likes hiking.
why: This is correct: 除了 with 也 means 'besides', adding a second thing.

q: 这个城市的地铁___来越方便了。
zh: 这个城市的地铁越来越方便了。
py: zhè ge chéng shì de dì tiě yuè lái yuè fāng biàn le
en: The subway in this city is getting more and more convenient.
why: The set phrase is 越来越, 'more and more'. 更 and 很 cannot replace 越 inside it.

q: 你先热身，___跑步。
zh: 你先热身，再跑步。
py: nǐ xiān rè shēn zài pǎo bù
en: Warm up first, then run.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the next step in an instruction. 又 is for something that already happened again; 也 means 'also'.

q: 无论你坐地铁___坐公交车，都能到市中心。
zh: 无论你坐地铁还是坐公交车，都能到市中心。
py: wú lùn nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shi zuò gōng jiāo chē dōu néng dào shì zhōng xīn
en: Whether you take the subway or the bus, you can get to the city centre.
why: After 无论 a choice question needs 还是 (A 还是 B). 或者 and 和 do not make a question form.

zh: 要是明天天气好的话，我们就骑自行车去公园。
py: yào shi míng tiān tiān qì hǎo de huà wǒ men jiù qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán
en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll cycle to the park.
why: 就 follows the second subject 我们 and stands before the verb phrase.

q: 即使明天有比赛，他___要去看电影。
zh: 即使明天有比赛，他也要去看电影。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài tā yě yào qù kàn diàn yǐng
en: Even if there is a match tomorrow, he still wants to see a film.
why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the second subject. 但是 and 所以 do not pair with it.

q: 不管明天下不下雨，我们___去爬山。
zh: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都去爬山。
py: bù guǎn míng tiān xià bu xià yǔ wǒ men dōu qù pá shān
en: Whether or not it rains tomorrow, we're going hiking.
why: 不管 plus a verb-not-verb question needs 都 after the second subject. 才 and 而且 cannot answer it.

q: 雨___下越大，比赛只好取消了。
zh: 雨越下越大，比赛只好取消了。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo qǔ xiāo le
en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so the match had to be cancelled.
why: 越下越大 is the 越 A 越 B pattern: the more it rains, the heavier. 更 and 又 cannot start it.

q: ___多晚回家，他都要先去公园走一圈。
zh: 不管多晚回家，他都要先去公园走一圈。
py: bù guǎn duō wǎn huí jiā tā dōu yào xiān qù gōng yuán zǒu yī quān
en: However late he gets home, he always takes a walk around the park first.
why: 多晚 is an open question and 都 is the partner, so the opener is 不管. 只要 would need 就 and 因为 would need 所以.

zh: 他的球越踢越好。
py: tā de qiú yuè tī yuè hǎo
en: His football gets better the more he plays.
why: 越 A 越 B puts 越 before the verb and again before the adjective. The two halves cannot be reversed.

zh: 如果你去踢球，我也去。
py: rú guǒ nǐ qù tī qiú wǒ yě qù
en: If you go and play football, I'll go too.
why: 也 is an adverb and stays after the second subject 我, right before 去. It cannot open the clause.

q: 这个周末，要么你来体育馆找我，___我去你家。
zh: 这个周末，要么你来体育馆找我，要么我去你家。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò yào me nǐ lái tǐ yù guǎn zhǎo wǒ yào me wǒ qù nǐ jiā
en: This weekend, either you come and find me at the gym or I'll come to your place.
why: Two options to choose between use 要么…要么. 而是 and 就是 belong with 不是.

q: 不但哥哥喜欢爬山，姐姐___喜欢。
zh: 不但哥哥喜欢爬山，姐姐也喜欢。
py: bù dàn gē ge xǐ huan pá shān jiě jie yě xǐ huan
en: Not only my brother likes hiking; my sister likes it too.
why: When the two clauses have different subjects, 不但 opens the first and 也 follows the second subject 姐姐. 就 and 才 are not partners of 不但.

q: 不管比赛结果___，我们都会为你加油。
zh: 不管比赛结果怎么样，我们都会为你加油。
py: bù guǎn bǐ sài jié guǒ zěn me yàng wǒ men dōu huì wèi nǐ jiā yóu
en: Whatever the result of the match, we'll cheer for you.
why: 不管 must be followed by a question form such as 怎么样. A plain statement like 很好 or 不好 cannot follow it.

s: 虽然天气不好，我们还是去公园了。
s_py: suī rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men hái shi qù gōng yuán le
zh: 虽然天气不好，我们还是去公园了。
py: suī rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men hái shi qù gōng yuán le
en: Although the weather was bad, we still went to the park.
why: This is correct. 还是 'still' can carry the contrast, so 但是 is not always needed.

zh: 因为地铁坏了，所以我们走路去体育馆。
py: yīn wèi dì tiě huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ men zǒu lù qù tǐ yù guǎn
en: Because the subway was out of service, we walked to the gym.
why: 所以 is a conjunction and comes before the second subject (or the subject is moved in front of 因为).

s: 即使天很冷，但是他们也去爬山。
s_py: jí shǐ tiān hěn lěng dàn shì tā men yě qù pá shān
zh: 即使天很冷，他们也去爬山。
py: jí shǐ tiān hěn lěng tā men yě qù pá shān
en: Even if it's very cold, they'll still go hiking.
why: 即使 is answered by 也. 但是 pairs with 虽然 and cannot be added after 即使.

s: 他不是在打球，但是在看球。
s_py: tā bù shì zài dǎ qiú dàn shì zài kàn qiú
zh: 他不是在打球，而是在看球。
py: tā bù shì zài dǎ qiú ér shì zài kàn qiú
en: He isn't playing; he's watching a game.
why: 不是 is completed by 而是 for a correction. 但是 cannot replace it.

q: 要是明天不下雨，我们___去踢足球。
zh: 要是明天不下雨，我们就去踢足球。
py: yào shi míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù tī zú qiú
en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go and play football.
why: 要是 (if) takes 就 after the second subject 我们. 才 would mean 'only then', which turns a simple if into a strict requirement.

q: 他们不是坐地铁去，___骑自行车去。
zh: 他们不是坐地铁去，而是骑自行车去。
py: tā men bù shì zuò dì tiě qù ér shì qí zì xíng chē qù
en: They aren't going by subway; they are going by bike.
why: The cue denies one way and states the true one: 不是 A 而是 B. 就是 would make it 'either subway or bike'.

zh: 即使今天输了比赛，我们也不会放弃。
py: jí shǐ jīn tiān shū le bǐ sài wǒ men yě bù huì fàng qì
en: Even if we lose the match today, we won't give up.
why: 也 is an adverb after the second subject 我们 and before 不会放弃.

s: 只要不下雨，比赛就照常进行。
s_py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ bǐ sài jiù zhào cháng jìn xíng
zh: 只要不下雨，比赛就照常进行。
py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ bǐ sài jiù zhào cháng jìn xíng
en: As long as it doesn't rain, the match goes ahead as normal.
why: This is correct: 只要 takes 就, placed after the second subject 比赛.

q: 周末他不是在球场打球，___在家看比赛。
zh: 周末他不是在球场打球，就是在家看比赛。
py: zhōu mò tā bù shì zài qiú chǎng dǎ qiú jiù shì zài jiā kàn bǐ sài
en: At weekends he is either playing ball on the court or watching a match at home.
why: The cue says it is always one of the two: 不是 A 就是 B. 而是 would correct a mistaken idea, and 要么 cannot follow 不是.

zh: 不管下不下雨，我们都去爬山。
py: bù guǎn xià bu xià yǔ wǒ men dōu qù pá shān
en: Whether it rains or not, we're going hiking.
why: 都 is an adverb: it follows the second-clause subject 我们 and comes before 去爬山.

s: 他既会骑自行车，又会开车，所以上班很方便。
s_py: tā jì huì qí zì xíng chē yòu huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ shàng bān hěn fāng biàn
zh: 他既会骑自行车，又会开车，所以上班很方便。
py: tā jì huì qí zì xíng chē yòu huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ shàng bān hěn fāng biàn
en: He can both ride a bike and drive, so getting to work is easy.
why: This is correct: 既…又 joins two abilities, and 所以 starts the result clause.

q: 除了踢足球，他___喜欢打乒乓球。
zh: 除了踢足球，他也喜欢打乒乓球。
py: chú le tī zú qiú tā yě xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú
en: Besides playing football, he also likes table tennis.
why: 'Besides' adds a second item, so 也 (or 还). 都 means 'all except', and there is only one object here.

q: 你先往前走，___往右转，就到了。
zh: 你先往前走，再往右转，就到了。
py: nǐ xiān wǎng qián zǒu zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le
en: Go straight first, then turn right, and you're there.
why: 先 starts the directions and 再 gives the next step. 才 would mean 'only then' and does not follow 先 here.

zh: 路上的车越来越多了。
py: lù shang de chē yuè lái yuè duō le
en: There are more and more cars on the road.
why: 越来越 comes directly before the adjective 多 with no 很, and 了 closes the sentence.

q: 尽管比赛已经结束了，观众们___不想离开体育馆。
zh: 尽管比赛已经结束了，观众们还是不想离开体育馆。
py: jǐn guǎn bǐ sài yǐ jīng jié shù le guān zhòng men hái shi bù xiǎng lí kāi tǐ yù guǎn
en: Even though the match was over, the spectators still didn't want to leave the stadium.
why: 尽管 states a fact and the outcome goes against it: 还是 'still'. 所以 and 因此 present a result and cannot follow 尽管.

q: ___买到便宜的票，他一大早就去排队了。
zh: 为了买到便宜的票，他一大早就去排队了。
py: wèi le mǎi dào pián yi de piào tā yī dà zǎo jiù qù pái duì le
en: In order to get cheap tickets, he went to queue first thing in the morning.
why: Getting cheap tickets is the goal of queueing, so 为了. 因为 would give a cause that already exists, and 既然 needs a fact to build on.

src: 他想进校队，所以每天早上练球。
src_py: tā xiǎng jìn xiào duì suǒ yǐ měi tiān zǎo shang liàn qiú
zh: 为了进校队，他每天早上练球。
py: wèi le jìn xiào duì tā měi tiān zǎo shang liàn qiú
en: In order to get into the school team, he practises every morning.
why: The goal becomes a 为了 phrase and 所以 is dropped, because 为了 and 所以 do not go together.

q: 只要不下雨，我们___去公园。
zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去公园。
py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán
en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park.
why: 只要 means one easy condition is enough and takes 就. 才 goes with 只有.

q: 只有对这座城市非常熟悉的人，___能不用地图找到那条小路。
zh: 只有对这座城市非常熟悉的人，才能不用地图找到那条小路。
py: zhǐ yǒu duì zhè zuò chéng shì fēi cháng shú xī de rén cái néng bù yòng dì tú zhǎo dào nà tiáo xiǎo lù
en: Only someone who knows this city very well can find that little lane without a map.
why: 只有 limits the condition to a special group and takes 才. 就 would mean anyone at all could do it.

s: 雨越下越大，我们只好回家了。
s_py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiā le
zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好回家了。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiā le
en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we had to go home.
why: This is correct: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective, with no 很 and no 越来越.

q: 我不是不想参加比赛，___最近工作太忙，没有时间练习。
zh: 我不是不想参加比赛，而是最近工作太忙，没有时间练习。
py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng cān jiā bǐ sài ér shì zuì jìn gōng zuò tài máng méi yǒu shí jiān liàn xí
en: It's not that I don't want to take part in the match; I've just been too busy at work to practise.
why: 不是…而是 corrects the supposed reason. 而且 would add information and 所以 would turn the real reason into a result.

q: 既然你想学游泳，我们___去报名吧。
zh: 既然你想学游泳，我们就去报名吧。
py: jì rán nǐ xiǎng xué yóu yǒng wǒ men jiù qù bào míng ba
en: Since you want to learn swimming, let's go and sign up.
why: 既然 introduces a known fact and takes 就 for the suggestion. 所以 and 因为 do not pair with 既然.

q: 除了星期天，我每天___去游泳。
zh: 除了星期天，我每天都去游泳。
py: chú le xīng qī tiān wǒ měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: I go swimming every day except Sunday.
why: Sunday is left out, so the partner is 都. 还 would mean 'in addition to Sunday', which makes no sense with 每天.

q: 她不但会游泳，___会打网球。
zh: 她不但会游泳，而且会打网球。
py: tā bù dàn huì yóu yǒng ér qiě huì dǎ wǎng qiú
en: She can not only swim, she can also play tennis.
why: 不但 is completed by 而且 (or 还), adding a second ability. 但是 and 所以 break the 'not only' structure.

q: 我越来越___骑自行车了。
zh: 我越来越喜欢骑自行车了。
py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan qí zì xíng chē le
en: I like cycling more and more.
why: 越来越 is followed directly by a feeling verb. 很 or 特别 cannot be added after it.

s: 既然你累了，我们才回家吧。
s_py: jì rán nǐ lèi le wǒ men cái huí jiā ba
zh: 既然你累了，我们就回家吧。
py: jì rán nǐ lèi le wǒ men jiù huí jiā ba
en: Since you're tired, let's go home.
why: 既然 leads to a suggestion with 就. 才 means 'only then' and clashes with a suggestion.

s: 只要穿上这双鞋，你才能跑得快。
s_py: zhǐ yào chuān shàng zhè shuāng xié nǐ cái néng pǎo de kuài
zh: 只要穿上这双鞋，你就能跑得快。
py: zhǐ yào chuān shàng zhè shuāng xié nǐ jiù néng pǎo de kuài
en: As long as you wear these shoes, you can run fast.
why: 只要 is answered by 就. 才 belongs with 只有.

q: 不管刮风下雨，他每天___去公园打太极拳。
zh: 不管刮风下雨，他每天都去公园打太极拳。
py: bù guǎn guā fēng xià yǔ tā měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán dǎ tài jí quán
en: Rain or shine, he goes to the park every day to do tai chi.
why: 不管 is answered by 都 after the subject. 才 would mean 'only then' and 但是 is a conjunction for 虽然.

q: 这个游泳池又大___深。
zh: 这个游泳池又大又深。
py: zhè ge yóu yǒng chí yòu dà yòu shēn
en: This swimming pool is both big and deep.
why: 又 is repeated before each adjective: 又大又深. 也 or 更 cannot be the second half.

q: 城市___大，交通问题___严重。
zh: 城市越大，交通问题越严重。
py: chéng shì yuè dà jiāo tōng wèn tí yuè yán zhòng
en: The bigger a city is, the more serious its traffic problems.
why: 'The more A, the more B' is 越 A 越 B. 又…又 would list two qualities and 很 cannot form a pair.

q: 妹妹游得越来越___了。
zh: 妹妹游得越来越好了。
py: mèi mei yóu de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: My younger sister swims better and better.
why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so the adjective stands bare. 很 and 非常 cannot follow it.
